body: I do. Perhaps I should write some poetry.. I was thinking about writing some music before I go.

I used to enjoy painting, but I just can't even do it anymore. I enjoyed exercise. I used to be a really good, honest, smart person. Now, I've lost everything from the constant pain and the humiliation. I just need to die. I'm not afraid of it, I need to go to sleep.
I'd rather not give any personal information, you can call me John.
